open_points.subject: A19 INV-033 required test witness
open_points.text: “a replacement of 1.00 against the 200.00 total is refused with `ExpenseValidationError` while the stored row counts stay unchanged; nothing spreads an amount”
open_points.question: Must the bound check verify that every previously stored allocation value and identity remains unchanged after the refused replacement, or is checking only row counts sufficient for the stated requirement that the refusal “changes nothing”?
options: Assert equality of the complete allocation set before and after the refusal
Assert only unchanged row counts and absence of automatically added allocations
open_points.default_guess: Assert equality of the complete stored allocation set before and after the refused replacement.

witness.initial: An expense totaling 200.00 has two stored allocations: 150.00 to a section and 50.00 to other expenses.
events: The verification check calls `replace_expense_allocations` with one explicit allocation of 1.00.
The check compares stored allocation row counts but the text does not say it compares their ids, targets, or amounts.
outcomes: The original 150.00 and 50.00 allocations remain exactly unchanged.
An implementation alters one or both existing allocation rows but inserts or deletes no rows; the stated row-count observation still passes.
witness.observer: The verification gate and any later reader of the expense allocations.
